function [p, receipt, space] = build_teacher_deep_crouch_parameter_proposal_v1(basePath, expectedBaseSHA, candidatesPath, expectedCandidatesSHA, candidateId, theta, outDir)
% Offline parameter serialization interface; no plant, reset or state control.
% ROOT alone may execute this in the existing MATLAB session, with NEW outDir.
% The current ROOT parameter base (including launch .14) is SHA-bound by caller.
% This file has NOT been executed by the source author or validated by MATLAB.
%
% theta = [vx, acceleration_s, crouch_s, push_s, extra_push_hold_s, ...
%          tuck_s, air_extend_s, pitch_gain_scale, pitch_rate_gain_scale].
% Bounds are a declared engineering SEARCH BOX, not physical speed limits.
% Empty theta uses the supplied base values, never the old launch .10 source.

assert(nargin == 7, 'Seven explicit source-interface inputs are required.');
assert(~isfolder(outDir) && ~isfile(outDir), 'Use an unconsumed NEW output directory.');
[created, message] = mkdir(outDir);
assert(created, message);
try
    [baseBytes, baseSHA] = readBytesAndSHA(basePath);
    [candidateBytes, candidateSHA] = readBytesAndSHA(candidatesPath);
    assert(strcmpi(baseSHA, expectedBaseSHA), 'Current ROOT base parameter SHA mismatch.');
    assert(strcmpi(candidateSHA, expectedCandidatesSHA), 'Candidate source artifact SHA mismatch.');
    p = jsondecode(native2unicode(baseBytes(:).', 'UTF-8'));
    doc = jsondecode(native2unicode(candidateBytes(:).', 'UTF-8'));
    assert(strcmp(doc.schema, 'OWN_MOD4_CROUCH_PARAMETER_CANDIDATES_SOURCE_V1'));
    assert(strcmp(doc.purpose, 'RESETBANK_OWN_FK_CROUCH_TEACHER_SOURCE_CPU_V1'));
    ids = {doc.candidates.candidate_id};
    ix = find(strcmp(ids, candidateId));
    assert(numel(ix) == 1, 'An exact unique candidate_id is required.');
    candidate = doc.candidates(ix);
    assert(candidate.neutral_static_reference_eligible && ~candidate.physical_teacher_valid);
    q = double(candidate.q4_action_order(:).');
    assert(numel(q) == 4 && all(isfinite(q)));
    assert(isempty(targetViolations(q)), 'Candidate is outside named motor/CAD limits. No clamp.');
    assert(p.leg_scale == .5 && p.wheel_scale == 10 && p.leg_nominal_kp == 60);
    assert(p.original_command_vx == .5, 'Original command publisher must remain .5.');
    base = p;
    space = struct();
    space.theta_names = {'teacher_vx', 'acceleration_s', 'crouch_s', 'push_s', ...
        'extra_push_hold_s', 'tuck_s', 'air_extend_s', 'wheel_pitch_gain_scale', ...
        'wheel_pitch_rate_gain_scale'};
    space.lower = [.5, .35, .12, .05, .02, .04, .06, .5, .5];
    space.upper = [1.6, .90, .40, .18, .12, .14, .18, 1.5, 1.5];
    space.bounds_scope = 'ENGINEERING_SEARCH_BOX_NOT_PHYSICAL_MAXIMA_OR_RUNTIME_GUARDS';
    if isempty(theta)
        theta = [base.teacher_vx, base.acceleration_s, base.crouch_s, base.push_s, ...
            base.extra_push_hold_s, base.tuck_s, base.air_extend_s, 1, 1];
    end
    theta = double(theta(:).');
    assert(numel(theta) == 9 && all(isfinite(theta)));
    assert(all(theta >= space.lower & theta <= space.upper), 'Theta outside declared search box. No clamp.');
    p.q_crouch4 = q;
    % The old crouch LP was solved at a DIFFERENT own q. It is not transplanted.
    % Zero is a position-reference feedforward choice, not zero physical gas/PD.
    p.push_tau_crouch4 = zeros(1, 4);
    p.teacher_vx = theta(1);
    p.acceleration_s = theta(2);
    p.crouch_s = theta(3);
    p.push_s = theta(4);
    p.extra_push_hold_s = theta(5);
    p.tuck_s = theta(6);
    p.air_extend_s = theta(7);
    p.wheel_pitch_gain = base.wheel_pitch_gain * theta(8);
    p.wheel_pitch_rate_gain = base.wheel_pitch_rate_gain * theta(9);

        ff = u*double(p.push_tau_extend4(:).');

            for crank = [1, 3]
                hip = crank+1;
                target(crank) = min(target(hip)+p.diff_max, max(target(hip)+p.diff_min, target(crank)));

                        'requested_leg_target4', target, 'violations', {violations}); %#ok<AGROW>
                end
            end
        end
    end

    receipt.status = 'SOURCE_PARAMETER_PROPOSAL_UNVALIDATED_NOT_RUNTIME_TEACHER';

function values = targetViolations(q)
lo = [-1.2, -.5, -1.2, -.5];
hi = [.9, .5, .9, .5];
names = {'left_crank', 'left_hip', 'right_crank', 'right_hip'};
values = {};
for i = 1:4
    if q(i) < lo(i) || q(i) > hi(i) || ~isfinite(q(i))
        values{end+1} = struct('joint', names{i}, 'value_rad', q(i), 'limits_rad', [lo(i), hi(i)]); %#ok<AGROW>
    end
end
for i = [1, 3]
    d = q(i)-q(i+1);
    if d < -1.0843 || d > .85
        values{end+1} = struct('CAD_crank_index', i, 'difference_rad', d, 'limits_rad', [-1.0843, .85]); %#ok<AGROW>
    end
end
end

function [bytes, sha] = readBytesAndSHA(path)
fid = fopen(path, 'rb');
assert(fid >= 0, 'Cannot open explicitly supplied source input.');
cleanup = onCleanup(@() fclose(fid)); %#ok<NASGU>
bytes = fread(fid, Inf, '*uint8');
sha = bytesSHA(bytes);
end

function sha = bytesSHA(bytes)
md = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance('SHA-256');
md.update(typecast(uint8(bytes(:)), 'int8'));
sha = lower(reshape(dec2hex(typecast(md.digest(), 'uint8'), 2).', 1, []));
end

function artifact = writeNewJSON(path, value)
assert(~isfile(path) && ~isfolder(path), 'Refuse to overwrite any previous result.');
bytes = [unicode2native(jsonencode(value, 'PrettyPrint', true), 'UTF-8'), uint8(10)];
fid = fopen(path, 'wb');
assert(fid >= 0, 'Cannot create new source result.');
cleanup = onCleanup(@() fclose(fid)); %#ok<NASGU>
written = fwrite(fid, bytes, 'uint8');
assert(written == numel(bytes), 'Short source result write.');
artifact = struct('path', path, 'bytes', numel(bytes), 'sha256', bytesSHA(bytes), ...
    'typed_kind', 'SMALL_SOURCE_PARAMETER_JSON_NOT_MODEL_RAW_OR_RUNTIME_APPROVAL');
end

def digest(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def load_source(name, raw, filename):
    module = types.ModuleType(name)
    module.__file__ = str(filename)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    exec(compile(raw.decode('utf-8-sig'), str(filename), 'exec'), module.__dict__)
    return module


def rpy_matrix(roll, pitch, yaw):
    cr, sr, cp, sp, cy, sy = math.cos(roll), math.sin(roll), math.cos(pitch), math.sin(pitch), math.cos(yaw), math.sin(yaw)
    return [[cy*cp, cy*sp*sr-sy*cr, cy*sp*cr+sy*sr],
            [sy*cp, sy*sp*sr+cy*cr, sy*sp*cr-cy*sr], [-sp, cp*sr, cp*cr]]


def target_domain(q4):
    violations = []
    for name, value, (lo, hi) in zip(ACTION4, q4, SDK4):
        if not math.isfinite(value) or value < lo or value > hi:
            violations.append(dict(joint=name, value=value, limits=[lo, hi]))
    differences = [q4[0]-q4[1], q4[2]-q4[3]]
    for side, difference in zip(('left', 'right'), differences):
        if not -1.0843 <= difference <= .85:
            violations.append(dict(CAD_difference_side=side, value=difference, limits=[-1.0843, .85]))
    return violations

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()

    report = dict(purpose=PURPOSE, status='EXPLICIT_PENDING', input_reads=[],
        source_path=str(Path(__file__).resolve()), source_sha256=digest(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
        interpreter=sys.executable, argv=sys.argv, producer_pid=os.getpid(), producer_parent_pid=os.getppid(),
        cwd=str(Path.cwd()), started_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),

        no_SDK_remote_MATLAB_model_PT_NPZ_raw_or_plant_access=True,

    code = 0
    try:
        run(report, args.candidates)
    except BaseException as error:
        code = 1

        report['error_type'] = type(error).__name__

"""Proposed ground-only nominal static reference map, not a deployed controller.

Input static torques/pitch must come from a source-bound feasible equilibrium.
This function has no plant, state/reset, force, SDK, model, RNG or file APIs.
It does NOT replace the frozen V1 phase logic or alter any original guard.
"""
import math


def ground_static_pd_reference_map_v1(*, q_reference4, static_torque6,
        equilibrium_pitch, pitch, pitch_rate, roll, roll_rate, yaw, yaw_rate,
        lateral_y, vx, desired_vx, wheel_forward_gain2,
        pitch_gain, pitch_rate_gain, speed_error_gain,
        yaw_gain=2., yaw_rate_gain=.5, lateral_gain=.5,
        roll_leg_gain=.15, roll_leg_rate_gain=.03, track_m=.4376,
        wheel_radius_m=.0625, leg_kp=60., wheel_kd=.6,
        supported_ground_reference=False):
    if supported_ground_reference is not True:
        raise ValueError('Static ground reference is unavailable in air or without an actual support cue')
    q = tuple(map(float, q_reference4))
    tau = tuple(map(float, static_torque6))
    gains = tuple(map(float, wheel_forward_gain2))
    if len(q) != 4 or len(tau) != 6 or len(gains) != 2:
        raise ValueError('Original named4/6/2 mapping required')
    values = q+tau+gains+(equilibrium_pitch,pitch,pitch_rate,roll,roll_rate,yaw,yaw_rate,lateral_y,
        vx,desired_vx,pitch_gain,pitch_rate_gain,speed_error_gain)
    if not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in values) or any(abs(g) < 1e-5 for g in gains):
        raise ValueError('Finite actual/reference inputs and signed nonzero own wheel gains required')
    if leg_kp != 60. or wheel_kd != .6 or wheel_radius_m != .0625:
        raise ValueError('This source proposal binds nominal original PD scales only')
    # Static torque is generated by original position/velocity PD, never by
    # applying a body force. The settled source queue still needs real delay.
    correction = roll_leg_gain*roll+roll_leg_rate_gain*roll_rate
    target = [x+t/leg_kp+d for x,t,d in zip(q,tau[:4],(correction,-correction,-correction,correction))]
    before_CAD = tuple(target)
    for crank in (0,2):
        target[crank] = min(target[crank+1]+.85,max(target[crank+1]-1.0843,target[crank]))
    omega = (vx/wheel_radius_m+pitch_gain*(pitch-equilibrium_pitch)
        +pitch_rate_gain*pitch_rate+speed_error_gain*(desired_vx-vx))
    yaw_target = -yaw_gain*yaw-yaw_rate_gain*yaw_rate-lateral_gain*lateral_y
    differential = track_m/(2*wheel_radius_m)*yaw_target
    wheel = [wheel_radius_m*(omega-differential)/gains[0]+tau[4]/wheel_kd,
             wheel_radius_m*(omega+differential)/gains[1]+tau[5]/wheel_kd]
    unclipped = tuple(x/.5 for x in target)+tuple(x/10. for x in wheel)
    raw = tuple(max(-6.,min(6.,x)) for x in unclipped)
    actual_motor_target = tuple(.5*x for x in raw[:4])+tuple(10.*x for x in raw[4:])
    named = ('left_crank','left_hip','right_crank','right_hip')
    domains = ((-1.2,.9),(-.5,.5),(-1.2,.9),(-.5,.5))
    target_outside_joint_domain = [dict(joint=n,target=x,state_domain=[lo,hi])
        for n,x,(lo,hi) in zip(named,actual_motor_target[:4],domains) if x < lo or x > hi]
    return dict(raw6=raw, unclipped_raw6=unclipped, processed_motor_target6=actual_motor_target,
        before_CAD_leg_target4=before_CAD, target_outside_joint_state_domain=target_outside_joint_domain,
        target_outside_joint_domain_is_NOT_actual_q_violation=True,
        deliberate_PD_target_saturation_possible=True,
        no_named_target_clamp=True, source_nominal_equilibrium_torque6=tau,
        pitch_reference=equilibrium_pitch, original_raw6_clipping_applied=raw != unclipped,
        original_CAD_projection_changed_target=tuple(target) != before_CAD,
        physical_teacher_valid=False, scope='SOURCE_GROUND_STATIC_TARGET_MAP_NOT_DEPLOYED_NOT_A_DYNAMIC_STABILITY_PROOF')

def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def require(value, message):
    if not value:

def module(name, raw, path):
    mod = types.ModuleType(name)
    mod.__file__ = str(path)
    sys.modules[name] = mod
    exec(compile(raw.decode('utf-8-sig'), str(path), 'exec'), mod.__dict__)
    return mod

    [C, meta] = readJSON(fullfile(B, 'job0', 'assets', 'import_contract.json'), '517cd6a4cc469455af08da75dc4b7f7cb596b375bafb4c3e566c7df5bc51df49', 'own_contract'); inputs(end+1) = meta;
    [G, meta] = readJSON(fullfile(B, 'source', 'OWN_STEP_WHEEL_GEOMETRY_FROM_R2_SOURCE.json'), '461f6b44e6014c72a755a0db5136fa8d45bd5b53b6318ee4b38221a4c597bc4d', 'own_geometry'); inputs(end+1) = meta;
    seedPath = fullfile(root139, 'reports', 'ROOT139_V2_MATLAB_CONSTRAINED_TEACHER_SEED_FIRST_ACTUAL', 'SEED_RESULT_ACTUAL.json');
    [S, meta] = readJSON(seedPath, '1345fbb0041eb0d2f9b9e11c0307007f5f9dfb73b8de734029d09d8f4c4b1219', 'projected_q_only_not_old_invalid_energy_fields'); inputs(end+1) = meta;
    candidatePath = fullfile(T, 'OWN_MOD4_RESETBANK_CROUCH_TEACHER_DIAGNOSTIC_CPU_V1_20261030', 'CROUCH_PARAMETER_CANDIDATES_SOURCE_CPU_V1_ACTUAL.json');
    [D, meta] = readJSON(candidatePath, '51cda1c1ba3b518c3851dcc468b37d1c35c01f97065f2e88700f8b9448c10181', 'crouch_source_candidates'); inputs(end+1) = meta;
    [p, meta] = readJSON(parameterPath, expectedParameterSHA, 'ROOT_unique_current_parameter_source'); inputs(end+1) = meta;
    inputs(end+1) = checkSource(fkFile, '94c67925ce701a46a322afff910c916dd0de2c41968d06bc294b92b1d2b99893', 'own_fk');
    inputs(end+1) = checkSource(matrixFile, '0cd6eb40378130064a5e327c04508bf0682901ad5b51c8d298e72d7d0a238ef4', 'corrected_gas2000_M_h_J');
    inputs(end+1) = checkSource(clipFile, '257a9753b8264d65634f01edf8ce47e4a27e3ee3a1f81bfcace42a090770015f', 'captured210_signed_clip_not72_equivalence');
    assert(strcmp(C.source_mjcf_sha256, 'fbb0393883d31ac96f8cd58a184585470222f7daf96af6aa5d0748a1752c366c'));
    assert(exist('fmincon', 'file') == 2 && exist('quadprog', 'file') == 2);
    addpath(fileparts(fkFile), '-begin');
    addpath(fileparts(matrixFile), '-begin');
    addpath(fileparts(clipFile), '-begin');
    clear own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1 own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1 dc_motor_signed_clip_from210_v1;
    assert(samePath(which('own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1'), fkFile));
    assert(samePath(which('own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1'), matrixFile));
    assert(samePath(which('dc_motor_signed_clip_from210_v1'), clipFile));
    names = cellstr(string(S.joint_names));
    assert(numel(names) == 30 && size(S.q30_reference_only, 2) == 30);
    order = {'left_crank', 'left_hip', 'right_crank', 'right_hip', 'left_wheel_spin', 'right_wheel_spin'};
    [found, act] = ismember(order, names); assert(all(found));
    qStand = S.q30_reference_only(1, :).';
    assert(max(abs(qStand(act(1:4))-double(p.q_stand4(:)))) < 1e-10, 'Current standing reference differs; freeze a new protocol.');
    assert(p.leg_nominal_kp == 60 && p.leg_scale == .5 && p.wheel_scale == 10);
    assert(p.original_command_vx == .5, 'Do not change the original command publisher.');
    poseQ = cell(4, 1);
    poseQ{1} = qStand;
    labels = {'stand_projected_seed', 'bank16_headroom', 'bank23_low_COM', 'landing_closed_for_current_q4'};
    for k = 2:3
        wanted = 16;
        if k == 3, wanted = 23; end
        ix = find([D.candidates.bank_index] == wanted);
        assert(numel(ix) == 1);
        dqNames = cellstr(string(D.joint_names_reference_order));
        [found, remap] = ismember(names, dqNames); assert(all(found));
        sourceQ = D.candidates(ix).full_q30_offline_reference_only(:);
        poseQ{k} = sourceQ(remap);
    end
    qLandTarget = double(p.q_land4(:));
    delta = S.q30_reference_only(:, act(1:4))-qLandTarget.';
    [~, seedIndex] = min(sum(delta.^2, 2));
    initial = S.q30_reference_only(seedIndex, :).';
    try
        [poseQ{4}, landingIK] = closeLanding(C, G, names, initial, act, qLandTarget);
    catch landingError
        poseQ{4} = [];
        landingIK = struct('status', 'ORIGINAL_LANDING_PASSIVE_IK_ERROR_RETAINED', ...
            'message', landingError.message, 'identifier', landingError.identifier, ...
            'stack', landingError.stack, 'physical_teacher_valid', false);
    end
    for k = 1:4
        try
            q = poseQ{k};
            if isempty(q)
                rows{k} = struct('pose', labels{k}, 'status', 'LANDING_IK_NOT_CLOSED_NO_STATIC_SOLVE', ...
                    'landing_IK', landingIK, 'physical_teacher_valid', false);
                continue;
            end
            qDomain = actualQDomain(C, names, q, act);
            baseFK = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q);
            assert(baseFK.closure_max_m <= .002, 'Source pose is not closed at the original2mm comparison.');
            assert(isempty(qDomain.actual_q30_violations) && isempty(qDomain.actual_CAD_violations), 'Real q is outside the source domain; do not clamp.');
            [angles, angleSolver] = alignCOM(C, G, names, q);
            neutralRoll = levelRoll(C, G, names, q, 0);
            variants = cell(2, 1);
            trials = [0, neutralRoll; angles(1), angles(2)];
            for v = 1:2
                pitch = trials(v, 1); roll = trials(v, 2);
                R = ry(pitch)*rx(roll);
                g0 = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q, zeros(3, 1), R);
                position = [0; 0; -mean(g0.wheel_low(3, :))];
                s = struct('p', position, 'R', R, 'v', zeros(3, 1), 'w', zeros(3, 1), 'q', q, 'dq', zeros(30, 1));
                d = own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(C, G, names, s);
                g = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q, position, R);
                [contactPoints, JC] = contactsAndJ(G, d);
                [balanceDistance, segmentFraction] = supportLine(g.COM, contactPoints);
                [~, rr, pivot] = qr(d.loop_J(:, 7:36).', 'vector');
                diagR = abs(diag(rr)); rankTolerance = 1e-9*max([diagR; 1]);
                loopRank = sum(diagR > rankTolerance); selected = pivot(1:loopRank);
                J = d.loop_J(selected, :);
                equilibrium = staticEffort(C, p, names, q, act, d, J, JC, []);
                % Exact-q hold at rest: frozen V1 SETTLE/STABILIZE/SUCCESS_HOLD
                % has no leg static feedforward and uses pitch reference0.
                % For bank poses this is an explicit candidate-hold comparison.
                c = p.roll_leg_gain*roll;
                frozenTarget = q(act(1:4))+c*[1; -1; -1; 1];
                frozenTorque = [60*(frozenTarget-q(act(1:4))); ...
                    .6*p.wheel_radius_m*p.wheel_pitch_gain*pitch./double(p.wheel_forward_gain2_m(:))];
                frozenActual = mapTorqueThroughOriginalPD(C, p, q, act, frozenTorque);
                noStaticBias = staticEffort(C, p, names, q, act, d, J, JC, frozenActual.actual_torque6_after_nominal_two_signed_clips);
                nonwheel = ~ismember(g.shape_body_index, [find(strcmp(g.body_names, 'left_wheel')), find(strcmp(g.body_names, 'right_wheel'))]);
                variants{v} = struct('reference', v, 'base_pitch_rad', pitch, 'base_roll_rad', roll, ...
                    'root_position_offline_floor_reference_only', position, 'R_world_from_chassis', R, ...
                    'COM_world_m', d.COM, 'support_points_world_m', contactPoints, ...
                    'COM_signed_distance_from_support_line_m', balanceDistance, ...
                    'COM_fraction_along_left_right_support_segment', segmentFraction, ...
                    'wheel_bottom_m', g.wheel_low(3, :), 'nonwheel_floor_min_m', min(g.shape_low(3, nonwheel)), ...
                    'all6_anchor_error_m', vecnorm(g.closure_residual), 'mimic_residual', g.mimic_residual, ...
                    'joint_only_loop_rank', loopRank, 'loop_rank_numerical_tolerance', rankTolerance, ...
                    'selected_loop_rows', selected, 'selected_loop_J_singular_values', svd(J), ...
                    'M_min_eigenvalue', min(eig((d.M+d.M.')/2)), 'nominal_gas', {d.gas}, ...
                    'required_static_solution', equilibrium, 'frozen_V1_exact_q_rest_PD', frozenActual, ...
                    'fixed_frozen_V1_torque_static_residual_solution', noStaticBias, ...
                    'q_state_domain', qDomain, 'physical_teacher_valid', false);
            end
            rows{k} = struct('pose', labels{k}, 'q30_offline_only', q, ...
                'q4_action_order', q(act(1:4)), 'initial_anchor_error_m', baseFK.closure_max_m, ...
                'angle_alignment_solver', angleSolver, 'variants', {variants}, ...
                'pose_or_velocity_not_written_to_any_plant', true, 'physical_teacher_valid', false);
            if k == 4, rows{k}.landing_passive_IK = landingIK; end
        catch poseError
            rows{k} = struct('pose', labels{k}, 'status', 'ORIGINAL_POSE_DIAGNOSTIC_ERROR_RETAINED', ...
                'message', poseError.message, 'identifier', poseError.identifier, 'stack', poseError.stack, ...
                'physical_teacher_valid', false);
        end
    end
    report = struct('schema', 'OWN_MOD4_STATIC_COM_PD_SOURCE_V1', ...
        'status', 'RETURNED_SOURCE_STATIC_COM_CONTACT_PD_DIAGNOSTIC_NOT_TEACHER', ...
        'producer_pid', feature('getpid'), 'inputs', inputs, 'rows', {rows}, ...
        'actuation_order', {order}, 'landing_IK', landingIK, ...
        'contact_model', 'Two exact authored wheel support points, point forces, mu.7 conservative L1; not PhysX contact patches', ...
        'nominal_noDR', true, 'gas_original_effort_limit_sim_N', 2000, ...
        'original_command_vx_preserved_m_s', p.original_command_vx, 'current_launch_front_not_changed_m', p.launch_front_m, ...
        'seed_energy_fields_not_used', true, 'source_static_only_no_integration_or_plant', true, ...
        'target_outside_joint_domain_is_not_actual_q_violation', true, ...
        'original_2mm_guard_not_changed', true, 'physical_teacher_valid', false);
catch error
    report = struct('schema', 'OWN_MOD4_STATIC_COM_PD_SOURCE_V1', ...
        'status', 'ORIGINAL_STATIC_SOURCE_ERROR_RETAINED', 'producer_pid', feature('getpid'), ...
        'message', error.message, 'identifier', error.identifier, 'stack', error.stack, ...
        'full_report', getReport(error, 'extended', 'hyperlinks', 'off'), ...
        'inputs', inputs, 'completed_rows', {rows}, 'physical_teacher_valid', false);
end
writeNewJSON(fullfile(outDir, 'STATIC_COM_PD_SOURCE_ACTUAL.json'), report);
end

function [q, receipt] = closeLanding(C, G, names, initial, act, target)
fixed = act(1:4);
dependent = [];
for j = 1:30
    child = C.joints.(names{j}).child;
    if ~ismember(j, fixed) && ~startsWith(names{j}, 'guide_roller_') && ~ismember(child, {'left_wheel', 'right_wheel'})
        dependent(end+1) = j; %#ok<AGROW>
    end
end
assert(numel(dependent) == 16, 'Own16 dependent passive/mimic coordinates expected.');
q = initial; q(fixed) = target;
lb = -inf(16, 1); ub = inf(16, 1);
for j = 1:16
    lim = C.joints.(names{dependent(j)}).limits_si;
    if ~isempty(lim), lb(j) = lim(1); ub(j) = lim(2); end
end
x0 = q(dependent);
assert(all(x0 >= lb & x0 <= ub), 'Initial guess is outside real authored bounds; do not silently clamp.');
before = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q);
options = optimoptions('fmincon', 'Display', 'off', 'Algorithm', 'sqp', ...
    'MaxIterations', 200, 'MaxFunctionEvaluations', 6000, 'FunctionTolerance', 1e-14, ...
    'OptimalityTolerance', 1e-10, 'StepTolerance', 1e-12);
objective = @(x) landingObjective(C, G, names, q, dependent, x);
[x, value, flag, solver] = fmincon(objective, x0, [], [], [], [], lb, ub, [], options);
q(dependent) = x;
after = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q);
receipt = struct('dependent_names', {names(dependent)}, 'fixed_motor_names', {names(fixed)}, ...
    'fixed_motor_target4', target, 'initial_anchor_max_m', before.closure_max_m, ...
    'solved_anchor_max_m', after.closure_max_m, 'mimic_residual', after.mimic_residual, ...
    'exitflag', flag, 'objective', value, 'solver', solver, ...
    'is_passive_interpolation_claimed_closed', false, 'physical_teacher_valid', false);
assert(after.closure_max_m <= .002 && max(abs(after.mimic_residual)) < 1e-6, 'Landing IK did not produce a closed offline pose.');
end

function value = landingObjective(C, G, names, q, dependent, x)
q(dependent) = x;
g = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q);
value = sum((1000*g.constraint_vector).^2);
end

function [angles, receipt] = alignCOM(C, G, names, q)
g = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q);
points = wheelSupportPoints(G, g.body_names, g.body_position, g.body_rotation);
delta = g.COM-mean(points, 2);
initial = [atan2(-delta(1), delta(3)); 0];
assert(abs(initial(1)) <= .6, 'COM balance initial pitch outside declared offline search range.');
options = optimoptions('fmincon', 'Display', 'off', 'Algorithm', 'sqp', ...
    'MaxIterations', 120, 'MaxFunctionEvaluations', 1200, 'FunctionTolerance', 1e-16, ...
    'OptimalityTolerance', 1e-10, 'StepTolerance', 1e-12);
objective = @(a) alignmentObjective(C, G, names, q, a);
[angles, value, flag, solver] = fmincon(objective, initial, [], [], [], [], [-.6; -.3], [.6; .3], [], options);
[~, errors] = alignmentObjective(C, G, names, q, angles);
receipt = struct('base_pitch_roll_rad', angles, 'initial_pitch_roll_rad', initial, ...
    'offline_search_bounds_pitch_roll_rad', [-.6, .6; -.3, .3], ...
    'search_bounds_are_not_actual_robot_limits', true, 'residual_COM_line_and_wheel_height_m', errors, ...
    'exitflag', flag, 'objective', value, 'solver', solver, ...
    'geometry_only_not_angular_momentum_or_dynamic_stability', true);
end

function [value, error] = alignmentObjective(C, G, names, q, angles)
g = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q, zeros(3, 1), ry(angles(1))*rx(angles(2)));
points = wheelSupportPoints(G, g.body_names, g.body_position, g.body_rotation);
distance = supportLine(g.COM, points);
error = [distance; points(3, 1)-points(3, 2)];
value = sum((1000*error).^2);
end

function roll = levelRoll(C, G, names, q, pitch)
fun = @(a) wheelHeightDifference(C, G, names, q, pitch, a);
assert(fun(-.3)*fun(.3) <= 0, 'Wheel-level roll is not bracketed in the offline comparison box.');
roll = fzero(fun, [-.3, .3]);
end

function difference = wheelHeightDifference(C, G, names, q, pitch, roll)
g = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q, zeros(3, 1), ry(pitch)*rx(roll));
difference = g.wheel_low(3, 1)-g.wheel_low(3, 2);
end

function [distance, fraction] = supportLine(COM, points)
line = points(1:2, 2)-points(1:2, 1);
offset = COM(1:2)-points(1:2, 1);
assert(norm(line) > .1, 'Own two wheel transverse support line required.');
distance = (line(2)*offset(1)-line(1)*offset(2))/norm(line);
fraction = (offset.'*line)/(line.'*line);
end

function solution = staticEffort(C, p, names, q, act, d, J, JC, fixedTorque)
r = size(J, 1); n = 6+r+6;
E = [d.B_action_torque_order6, J.', JC.'];
b = d.h-d.gas_generalized_force;
peak = [C.leg_motor.peak_torque_nm*ones(4, 1); C.wheel_motor.peak_torque_nm*ones(2, 1)];
continuous = [C.leg_motor.continuous_torque_nm*ones(4, 1); C.wheel_motor.continuous_torque_nm*ones(2, 1)];
lb = [-peak; -inf(r+6, 1)]; ub = [peak; inf(r+6, 1)];
if ~isempty(fixedTorque)
    lb(1:6) = fixedTorque; ub(1:6) = fixedTorque;
end
for wheel = 1:2, lb(6+r+(wheel-1)*3+3) = 0; end
A = []; rhs = []; mu = .7;
for wheel = 1:2
    idx = 6+r+(wheel-1)*3+(1:3);
    for sx = [-1, 1]
        for sy = [-1, 1]
            row = zeros(1, n); row(idx) = [sx, sy, -mu];
            A = [A; row]; rhs = [rhs; 0]; %#ok<AGROW>
        end
    end
end
for j = 1:4
    % Position targets may exceed a named JOINT STATE limit intentionally.
    % Only original raw +/-6 and CAD target projection constrain this solve.
    row = zeros(1, n); row(j) = 1/60;
    A = [A; row; -row]; rhs = [rhs; 3-q(act(j)); 3+q(act(j))]; %#ok<AGROW>
end
for j = [1, 3]
    row = zeros(1, n); row(j) = 1/60; row(j+1) = -1/60;
    delta = q(act(j))-q(act(j+1));
    A = [A; row; -row]; rhs = [rhs; p.diff_max-delta; delta-p.diff_min]; %#ok<AGROW>
end
for j = 5:6
    row = zeros(1, n); row(j) = 1/.6;
    A = [A; row; -row]; rhs = [rhs; 60; 60]; %#ok<AGROW>
end
[~, RR, pivot] = qr(E.', 'vector'); diagonal = abs(diag(RR));
eqTolerance = 1e-10*max([diagonal; 1]); eqRank = sum(diagonal > eqTolerance);
selectedEq = pivot(1:eqRank);
H = diag([1./peak.^2; 1e-12*ones(r, 1); 1e-8/(d.total_mass_kg*9.81)^2*ones(6, 1)]);
options = optimoptions('quadprog', 'Display', 'off', 'Algorithm', 'interior-point-convex', ...
    'MaxIterations', 400, 'ConstraintTolerance', 1e-9, 'OptimalityTolerance', 1e-9);
[z, value, flag, solver] = quadprog(H, zeros(n, 1), A, rhs, E(selectedEq, :), b(selectedEq), lb, ub, [], options);
hardFlag = flag; hardSolver = solver; usedSoft = false;
if isempty(z) || flag <= 0 || max(abs(E*z-b)) > 1e-6
    % A bounded least-residual diagnostic is preserved as a failure to prove
    % static equilibrium. It is never relabelled as an equality solution.
    scale = ones(36, 1)/40;
    scale(1:3) = 1/(d.total_mass_kg*9.81);
    scale(4:6) = 1/(d.total_mass_kg*9.81*.3);
    for j = 1:30
        if strcmp(C.joints.(names{j}).type, 'slide'), scale(6+j) = 1/(d.total_mass_kg*9.81); end
    end
    W2 = diag(scale.^2);
    softH = E.'*W2*E+1e-8*H;
    softH = (softH+softH.')/2;
    [z, value, flag, solver] = quadprog(softH, -E.'*W2*b, A, rhs, [], [], lb, ub, [], options);
    usedSoft = true;
end
if isempty(z) || any(~isfinite(z))
    solution = struct('status', 'NO_STATIC_OR_BOUNDED_RESIDUAL_SOLUTION', ...
        'hard_exitflag', hardFlag, 'hard_solver', hardSolver, ...
        'last_exitflag', flag, 'last_solver', solver, 'physical_teacher_valid', false);
    return;
end
tau = z(1:6); lambda = z(7:6+r); forces = reshape(z(7+r:end), 3, 2);
residual = E*z-b;
pd = mapTorqueThroughOriginalPD(C, p, q, act, tau);
mappedResidual = d.B_action_torque_order6*pd.actual_torque6_after_nominal_two_signed_clips+J.'*lambda+JC.'*forces(:)-b;
maxConstraintViolation = max([0; A*z-rhs; lb-z; z-ub]);
isEquality = ~usedSoft && flag > 0 && max(abs(residual)) <= 1e-6 ...
    && max(abs(mappedResidual)) <= 1e-6 && maxConstraintViolation <= 1e-6;
status = 'BOUNDED_LEAST_RESIDUAL_NOT_A_STATIC_EQUILIBRIUM_PROOF';
if isEquality, status = 'ALTERNATE_POINT_CONTACT_STATIC_EQUATIONS_SATISFIED_NOT_PHYSX_OR_STABILITY'; end
solution = struct('status', status, 'hard_exitflag', hardFlag, 'hard_solver', hardSolver, ...
    'used_soft_residual_fallback', usedSoft, 'last_exitflag', flag, 'last_solver', solver, ...
    'objective', value, 'tau6_Nm', tau, 'loop_lambda_selected', lambda, ...
    'ground_reaction_world_N', forces, 'mu_assumed_not_measured', mu, ...
    'static_generalized_residual36', residual, 'root_force_residual_N', residual(1:3), ...
    'root_moment_residual_Nm', residual(4:6), 'joint_generalized_residual30', residual(7:36), ...
    'max_mixed_unit_residual', max(abs(residual)), ...
    'all36_residual_after_original_PD_and_clips', mappedResidual, ...
    'static_linear_system_rank', eqRank, 'selected_equality_rows', selectedEq, ...
    'equality_rank_numerical_tolerance', eqTolerance, 'static_matrix_singular_values', svd(E), ...
    'unbounded_nullspace_consistency_residual', b-E*(pinv(E)*b), ...
    'max_inequality_or_bound_violation', maxConstraintViolation, 'peak_effort_limit6_Nm', peak, ...
    'remaining_peak_effort6_Nm', peak-abs(tau), 'continuous_rating6_Nm', continuous, ...
    'within_continuous_rating6', abs(tau) <= continuous, ...
    'continuous_rating_is_not_the_original_runtime_clip', true, ...
    'nominal_PD_target', pd, 'all_velocities_zero', true, ...
    'steady_queue_required_before_claiming_PD_torque', true, ...
    'no_duration_thermal_or_dynamic_stability_proof', true, 'physical_teacher_valid', false);
end

function result = mapTorqueThroughOriginalPD(C, p, q, act, torque)
leg = q(act(1:4))+torque(1:4)/60;
wheel = torque(5:6)/.6;
requestedTarget = [leg; wheel];
rawBefore = [leg/.5; wheel/10];
raw = max(-6, min(6, rawBefore));
processed = [.5*raw(1:4); 10*raw(5:6)];
for j = [1, 3]
    processed(j) = min(processed(j+1)+p.diff_max, max(processed(j+1)+p.diff_min, processed(j)));
end
requested = [60*(processed(1:4)-q(act(1:4))); .6*processed(5:6)];
limit = [C.leg_motor.peak_torque_nm*ones(4, 1); C.wheel_motor.peak_torque_nm*ones(2, 1)];
stall = [C.leg_motor.envelope_intercept_nm*ones(4, 1); C.wheel_motor.envelope_intercept_nm*ones(2, 1)];
speed = [C.leg_motor.no_load_speed_rpm*2*pi/60*ones(4, 1); C.wheel_motor.no_load_speed_rpm*2*pi/60*ones(2, 1)];
[first, clip1] = dc_motor_signed_clip_from210_v1(requested, zeros(6, 1), limit, stall, speed);
[actual, clip2] = dc_motor_signed_clip_from210_v1(first, zeros(6, 1), limit, stall, speed);
outside = [];
for j = 1:4
    limits = C.joints.(pActionName(j)).limits_si;
    if processed(j) < limits(1) || processed(j) > limits(2), outside(end+1) = j; end %#ok<AGROW>
end
result = struct('requested_equivalent_torque6_Nm', torque, 'qtarget_equals_q_plus_tau_over_kp4', requestedTarget(1:4), ...
    'wheel_velocity_target2_rad_s', wheel, 'raw6_before_original_clip', rawBefore, ...
    'raw6_after_original_clip', raw, 'processed_target6_after_CAD', processed, ...
    'actual_torque6_after_nominal_two_signed_clips', actual, 'actual_minus_equivalent_torque6', actual-torque, ...
    'nominal_episode_step_scales6', ones(6, 1), 'two_clip_origin_captured210_not72_runtime_equivalence', true, ...
    'first_clip', clip1, 'second_clip', clip2, 'target_outside_named_q_domain_indices', outside, ...
    'target_outside_named_q_domain_is_not_actual_q_limit_violation', true, ...
    'deliberate_PD_saturation_is_possible_and_must_be_reported', true, ...
    'state_not_clamped_or_modified', true, 'no_external_force', true);
end

function name = pActionName(j)
names = {'left_crank', 'left_hip', 'right_crank', 'right_hip'};
name = names{j};
end

function domain = actualQDomain(C, names, q, act)
violations = struct('joint', {}, 'q', {}, 'limits', {});
for j = 1:30
    lim = C.joints.(names{j}).limits_si;
    if ~isfinite(q(j)) || (~isempty(lim) && (q(j) < lim(1) || q(j) > lim(2)))
        violations(end+1) = struct('joint', names{j}, 'q', q(j), 'limits', lim); %#ok<AGROW>
    end
end
cad = [];
for j = [1, 3]
    delta = q(act(j))-q(act(j+1));
    if delta < -1.0843 || delta > .85, cad(end+1) = j; end %#ok<AGROW>
end
domain = struct('actual_q30_violations', violations, 'actual_CAD_violations', cad, ...
    'no_actual_state_clamp', true, 'actual_q_and_PD_target_domains_are_distinct', true);
end

function [points, JC] = contactsAndJ(G, d)
names = cellstr(string(G.body_names));
points = wheelSupportPoints(G, names, d.body_position, d.body_rotation);
JC = zeros(6, 36);
for j = 1:2
    wheels = {'left_wheel', 'right_wheel'};
    b = find(strcmp(names, wheels{j}), 1);
    offset = points(:, j)-d.body_position(:, b);
    JC((j-1)*3+(1:3), :) = d.body_origin_Jv(:, :, b)-skew(offset)*d.body_Jw(:, :, b);
end
end

function points = wheelSupportPoints(G, bodyNames, P, R)
shapes = G.shapes; if isstruct(shapes), shapes = num2cell(shapes); end
wheelNames = {'left_wheel', 'right_wheel'};
points = zeros(3, 2);
for j = 1:2
    b = find(strcmp(bodyNames, wheelNames{j}), 1);
    ix = find(cellfun(@(s) strcmp(s.body, wheelNames{j}), shapes));
    assert(numel(ix) == 1 && strcmp(shapes{ix}.type, 'Mesh'), 'Own exact single wheel mesh required.');
    shape = shapes{ix};
    vertices = R(:, :, b)*shape.linear_body_from_shape*shape.points.'+P(:, b)+R(:, :, b)*shape.origin_body_m(:);
    z = min(vertices(3, :));
    points(:, j) = mean(vertices(:, abs(vertices(3, :)-z) < 1e-12), 2);
end
end

function [value, meta] = readJSON(path, expected, key)
[bytes, meta] = readPinned(path, expected, key);
value = jsondecode(native2unicode(bytes(:).', 'UTF-8'));
end

function meta = checkSource(path, expected, key)
[~, meta] = readPinned(path, expected, key);
end

function [bytes, meta] = readPinned(path, expected, key)
fid = fopen(path, 'rb'); assert(fid >= 0, 'Cannot open an explicitly bound source input.');
close = onCleanup(@() fclose(fid)); %#ok<NASGU>
bytes = fread(fid, Inf, '*uint8');
sha = bytesSHA(bytes);
assert(strcmpi(sha, expected), ['Source/input SHA mismatch: ', key]);
meta = struct('key', key, 'path', path, 'bytes', numel(bytes), 'sha256', sha, 'read_count', 1);
end

function same = samePath(a, b)
same = strcmpi(strrep(a, '\', '/'), strrep(b, '\', '/'));
end

function sha = bytesSHA(bytes)
md = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance('SHA-256');
md.update(typecast(uint8(bytes(:)), 'int8'));
sha = lower(reshape(dec2hex(typecast(md.digest(), 'uint8'), 2).', 1, []));
end

function writeNewJSON(path, value)
assert(~isfile(path) && ~isfolder(path), 'Refuse to overwrite original result.');
fid = fopen(path, 'wb'); assert(fid >= 0);
close = onCleanup(@() fclose(fid)); %#ok<NASGU>
bytes = [unicode2native(jsonencode(value, 'PrettyPrint', true), 'UTF-8'), uint8(10)];
assert(fwrite(fid, bytes, 'uint8') == numel(bytes), 'Short result write.');
end

function R = rx(a)
R = [1, 0, 0; 0, cos(a), -sin(a); 0, sin(a), cos(a)];
end

function R = ry(a)
R = [cos(a), 0, sin(a); 0, 1, 0; -sin(a), 0, cos(a)];
end

function S = skew(v)
S = [0, -v(3), v(2); v(3), 0, -v(1); -v(2), v(1), 0];
end

"""Original raw6 target reference controller for ROOT's NEW zero-PT PhysX case.

Pure scalar source. No SDK, model, force, reset, state or command-publisher API.
All body motion/contact/limits/qualification are produced by the original plant.
This is an unvalidated parameterized teacher CANDIDATE, never a success oracle.

from dataclasses import dataclass
import math

ACTION_ORDER=('left_crank','left_hip','right_crank','right_hip','left_wheel_spin','right_wheel_spin')
FLIGHT_PHASES={'FLIGHT_TUCK','AIR_EXTEND'}
GROUND_PHASES={'SETTLE','BACKOFF','BRAKE_BACKOFF','ACCELERATE','CROUCH','CROUCH_COAST','PUSH','PUSH_HOLD','LAND_ABSORB','STABILIZE','SUCCESS_HOLD','ABORT_BRAKE'}


def smooth(x):
    x=max(0.,min(1.,x));return x*x*(3.-2.*x)


def blend(a,b,u):return tuple((1-u)*x+u*y for x,y in zip(a,b))


def wheel_forward_gains_from_own_fk(C,G,names,q):
    """Pure own FK at task yaw0: vX=-[omega_axis cross r_contact]_X.

    This determines signs/mesh no-slip conversion, not measured slip or speed.
    Contract joint-frame quaternions are wxyz; no SDK xyzw ambiguity is used.
    """
    mm=lambda A,B:[[sum(A[i][k]*B[k][j] for k in range(3)) for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)]
    mv=lambda A,x:[sum(A[i][k]*x[k] for k in range(3)) for i in range(3)]
    tr=lambda A:list(map(list,zip(*A)))
    def rotation(q):
        z=math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in q));w,x,y,z0=(v/z for v in q)
        return [[1-2*(y*y+z0*z0),2*(x*y-w*z0),2*(x*z0+w*y)],
            [2*(x*y+w*z0),1-2*(x*x+z0*z0),2*(y*z0-w*x)],
            [2*(x*z0-w*y),2*(y*z0+w*x),1-2*(x*x+y*y)]]
    bychild={row['child']:(name,row) for name,row in C['joints'].items()};values=dict(zip(names,map(float,q)))
    poses={'chassis':([0.,0.,0.],[[1.,0.,0.],[0.,1.,0.],[0.,0.,1.]])}
    def pose(body):
        if body in poses:return poses[body]
        name,row=bychild[body];pp,PR=pose(row['parent']);a=values[name]
        A=mm(PR,rotation(row['local_rot0']));axis=[x[0] for x in A]
        if row['type']=='hinge':motion=[[1.,0.,0.],[0.,math.cos(a),-math.sin(a)],[0.,math.sin(a),math.cos(a)]]
        else:motion=[[1.,0.,0.],[0.,1.,0.],[0.,0.,1.]]
        R=mm(mm(A,motion),tr(rotation(row['local_rot1'])))
        anchor=mv(PR,row['local_pos0']);offset=mv(R,row['local_pos1'])
        p=[pp[i]+anchor[i]-offset[i]+(axis[i]*a if row['type']=='slide' else 0.) for i in range(3)]
        poses[body]=(p,R);return p,R
    proof=[];gains=[]
    for joint in ('left_wheel_spin','right_wheel_spin'):
        row=C['joints'][joint];parent_p,parent_R=pose(row['parent']);wp,WR=pose(row['child'])
        A=mm(parent_R,rotation(row['local_rot0']));axis=[x[0] for x in A]
        anchor=mv(parent_R,row['local_pos0']);anchor=[parent_p[i]+anchor[i] for i in range(3)]
        shape=next(h for h in G['shapes'] if h['body']==row['child']);assert shape['type']=='Mesh'
        vertices=[]
        for point in shape['points']:
            point=mv(shape['linear_body_from_shape'],point)
            point=[point[i]+shape['origin_body_m'][i] for i in range(3)];point=mv(WR,point)
            vertices.append([wp[i]+point[i] for i in range(3)])
        zmin=min(x[2] for x in vertices);ties=[x for x in vertices if abs(x[2]-zmin)<=1e-12]
        contact=[sum(x[i] for x in ties)/len(ties) for i in range(3)];r=[contact[i]-anchor[i] for i in range(3)]
        gain=-(axis[1]*r[2]-axis[2]*r[1]);assert abs(gain)>1e-5
        gains.append(gain);proof.append(dict(joint=joint,axis_world3=axis,r_contact_from_joint3=r,
            positive_joint_rad_s1_world_vx_no_slip=gain,negative_joint_rad_s1_world_vx_no_slip=-gain,
            quaternion_convention='imported_joint_frames_wxyz',scope='OWN_FK_YAW0_NO_SLIP_KINEMATICS_NOT_MEASURED_SLIP'))
    return tuple(gains),proof


@dataclass(frozen=True)

    def __post_init__(self):
        for name in ('q_stand4','q_crouch4','q_air_tuck4','q_land4','push_tau_crouch4','push_tau_extend4'):
            values=tuple(float(x) for x in getattr(self,name));assert len(values)==4 and all(math.isfinite(x) for x in values),name
            object.__setattr__(self,name,values)
        assert max(map(abs,self.push_tau_crouch4+self.push_tau_extend4))<=40.000001

    @property
    def runway_start_front_m(self):
        # Includes ground crouch + push distance; the kinematic seed's-.20
        # acceleration-only runway is not silently reused as a real reset.
        distance=self.teacher_vx*(.5*self.acceleration_s+self.crouch_s+self.push_s)+self.runway_margin_m

def validate_observation(o):
    scalar=('root_pitch','root_roll','root_yaw','root_y','actual_command_vx')
    arrays={'world_velocity3':3,'world_angular_velocity3':3,'wheel_front2':2,'wheel_bottom2':2,'wheel_N2':2}
    for k in scalar:
        if k not in o or not math.isfinite(float(o[k])):raise ValueError('Missing/nonfinite actual observation: '+k)
    for k,n in arrays.items():
        if k not in o or len(o[k])!=n or not all(math.isfinite(float(x)) for x in o[k]):raise ValueError('Bad actual observation: '+k)
    for k in ('episode_id','global_control','public_age'):
        if k not in o or isinstance(o[k],bool) or not isinstance(o[k],int):raise ValueError('Integer original identity required: '+k)
    for k in ('request_active','clean_air_now','full_footprint','original_success','original_done'):
        if k not in o or type(o[k]) is not bool:raise ValueError('Actual bool or explicit missing-input failure required: '+k)
    for k in ('process_ready','qualified'):
        if k not in o or (o[k] is not None and type(o[k]) is not bool):raise ValueError('Actual bool or explicit UNKNOWN None required: '+k)
    for k in ('top_support_cue2','crossed2'):
        if k not in o or len(o[k])!=2 or any(type(x) is not bool for x in o[k]):raise ValueError('Actual bool2 required: '+k)
    if o['clean_air_now'] and (min(o['wheel_bottom2'])<=.005 or max(o['wheel_N2'])>1.000001):
        raise ValueError('Incoherent original clean-air/current force/bottom inputs; do not fabricate flight')
    if not 0<=o['global_control']<2000:raise ValueError('Original global2000-control cap')
    if 'actual_joint_q4' in o and (len(o['actual_joint_q4'])!=4 or not all(math.isfinite(float(x)) for x in o['actual_joint_q4'])):
        raise ValueError('Bad optional actual named leg positions')


class OwnMOD4TeacherReference:
    def __init__(self,parameters):
        self.p=parameters;self.episode=None;self.phase='UNINITIALIZED';self.started=0.
        self.last_leg=parameters.q_stand4;self.start_leg=self.last_leg
        self.had_air=False;self.air_start=None;self.flight_id=0;self.last_air=False
        self.brake_stopped_since=None;self.failure_reason=None;self.last_global_control=None

    def _set(self,phase,t):
        if phase!=self.phase:
            self.phase=phase;self.started=t;self.start_leg=self.last_leg

    def bootstrap(self,q30,joint_names,global_control=0):
        """One first action from actual initialized q; contact is UNKNOWN.

        ROOT must never fabricate zero force before the first physical cache.
        This holds actual leg targets and requests zero wheel velocity only.
        """
        if self.last_global_control is not None or global_control!=0:raise ValueError('Bootstrap is only the first action of a NEW case')
        if len(q30)!=30 or len(joint_names)!=30:raise ValueError('Actual named30 initialization required')
        q=[float(q30[joint_names.index(name)]) for name in ACTION_ORDER[:4]]
        if not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in q):raise ValueError('Nonfinite actual initial q')
        for i in (0,2):q[i]=min(q[i+1]+self.p.diff_max,max(q[i+1]+self.p.diff_min,q[i]))
        raw=tuple(max(-6.,min(6.,x/self.p.leg_scale)) for x in q)+(0.,0.)
        self.last_global_control=0;self.last_leg=tuple(q);self.start_leg=self.last_leg
        return dict(raw6=raw,phase='BOOTSTRAP_CONTACT_UNKNOWN',force_and_contact='UNKNOWN_NO_PHYSICAL_CALLBACK_YET',
            original_success='UNKNOWN',physical_teacher_valid=False,no_state_force_reset_or_goal_write=True)

    def step(self,o):
        validate_observation(o)
        p=self.p;t=.01*o['global_control'];air=o['clean_air_now']
        if self.last_global_control is not None and o['global_control']<=self.last_global_control:
            raise ValueError('Replayed/reversed control; new purpose/episode must not reuse consumed controls')
        if self.episode!=o['episode_id']:
            self.episode=o['episode_id'];self.phase='SETTLE';self.started=t
            self.start_leg=tuple(o.get('actual_joint_q4',self.last_leg));self.last_leg=self.start_leg
            self.had_air=False;self.air_start=None;self.last_air=False;self.brake_stopped_since=None;self.failure_reason=None
        self.last_global_control=o['global_control']
        if o['original_done']:
            self._set('TERMINATED',t)
        elif o['original_success']:
            self._set('SUCCESS_HOLD',t)
        elif not o['request_active']:
            self._set('SETTLE',t)
        elif air:
            if not self.last_air:
                self.flight_id+=1;self.had_air=True;self.air_start=t;self._set('FLIGHT_TUCK',t)
            descending=o['world_velocity3'][2]<0
            if self.phase=='FLIGHT_TUCK' and (t-self.started>=p.tuck_s) and descending:
                if all(o['crossed2']) or (min(o['wheel_front2'])>=.37 and min(o['wheel_bottom2'])>=p.minimum_bottom_before_air_extend_m):
                    self._set('AIR_EXTEND',t)
        elif self.had_air and self.last_air:
            if any(o['top_support_cue2']):self._set('LAND_ABSORB',t)
            else:self.failure_reason='real_contact_before_top_landing';self._set('ABORT_BRAKE',t)
        else:
            elapsed=t-self.started
            if self.phase=='SETTLE':self._set('BACKOFF' if max(o['wheel_front2'])>p.runway_start_front_m+.015 else 'BRAKE_BACKOFF',t)
            elif self.phase=='BACKOFF' and max(o['wheel_front2'])<=p.runway_start_front_m+.015:self._set('BRAKE_BACKOFF',t)
            elif self.phase=='BRAKE_BACKOFF':
                if abs(o['world_velocity3'][0])<.1:
                    if self.brake_stopped_since is None:self.brake_stopped_since=t
                    if t-self.brake_stopped_since>=p.brake_hold_s:self._set('ACCELERATE',t)
                else:self.brake_stopped_since=None
            elif self.phase=='ACCELERATE' and elapsed>=p.acceleration_s:self._set('CROUCH',t)
            elif self.phase=='CROUCH' and elapsed>=p.crouch_s:self._set('CROUCH_COAST',t)
            elif self.phase=='CROUCH_COAST' and max(o['wheel_front2'])>=p.launch_front_m-p.teacher_vx*p.push_s:self._set('PUSH',t)
            elif self.phase=='PUSH' and elapsed>=p.push_s:self._set('PUSH_HOLD',t)
            elif self.phase=='PUSH_HOLD' and elapsed>=p.extra_push_hold_s:
                self.failure_reason='no_true_both_wheel_takeoff';self._set('ABORT_BRAKE',t)
            elif self.phase=='LAND_ABSORB' and elapsed>=p.landing_absorb_s:self._set('STABILIZE',t)
        # Late grounded approach is a failed reference; braking never changes
        # original reset/termination/event counters or manufactures clearance.
        if self.phase in {'ACCELERATE','CROUCH','CROUCH_COAST','PUSH','PUSH_HOLD'}:

        if self.phase=='SETTLE':leg=blend(self.start_leg,p.q_stand4,smooth(elapsed/p.settle_pose_s))
        elif self.phase=='BACKOFF':

            desired_vx=-min(p.backoff_speed_m_s,max(.10,1.5*distance));leg=p.q_stand4

        elif self.phase=='CROUCH':desired_vx=p.teacher_vx;leg=blend(self.start_leg,p.q_crouch4,smooth(elapsed/p.crouch_s))
        elif self.phase=='CROUCH_COAST':desired_vx=p.teacher_vx;leg=p.q_crouch4

        elif self.phase=='AIR_EXTEND':desired_vx=p.teacher_vx;leg=blend(self.start_leg,p.q_stand4,smooth(elapsed/p.air_extend_s))
        elif self.phase=='LAND_ABSORB':leg=blend(self.start_leg,p.q_land4,smooth(elapsed/p.landing_absorb_s))
        elif self.phase=='STABILIZE':leg=blend(self.start_leg,p.q_stand4,smooth(elapsed/p.recovery_rise_s))
        else:leg=p.q_stand4
        self.last_leg=tuple(leg)
        command=[q+tau/p.leg_nominal_kp for q,tau in zip(leg,ff)]

            correction=p.roll_leg_gain*o['root_roll']+p.roll_leg_rate_gain*o['world_angular_velocity3'][0]
            command=[q+d for q,d in zip(command,(correction,-correction,-correction,correction))]
        for i in (0,2):command[i]=min(command[i+1]+p.diff_max,max(command[i+1]+p.diff_min,command[i]))
        vx=o['world_velocity3'][0]
        # Ground wheel-balance seed: gains are engineering/controller values,
        # not physical forces or a promise of stability. In air this requests
        # wheel reaction/landing speed, never direct COM acceleration.
        omega=vx/p.wheel_radius_m+p.wheel_pitch_gain*o['root_pitch']+p.wheel_pitch_rate_gain*o['world_angular_velocity3'][1]+p.speed_error_gain*(desired_vx-vx)
        yaw_rate=-p.yaw_gain*o['root_yaw']-p.yaw_rate_gain*o['world_angular_velocity3'][2]-p.lateral_gain*o['root_y']

        unbounded=[q/p.leg_scale for q in command]+[p.wheel_radius_m*(omega-differential)/p.wheel_forward_gain2_m[0]/p.wheel_scale,
            p.wheel_radius_m*(omega+differential)/p.wheel_forward_gain2_m[1]/p.wheel_scale]
        raw=tuple(max(-6.,min(6.,x)) for x in unbounded)
        self.last_air=air
        return dict(raw6=raw,phase=self.phase,planned_leg_target4=tuple(command),nominal_push_feedforward_tau4=ff,
            requested_teacher_vx=desired_vx,actual_original_command_vx=o['actual_command_vx'],
            command_publisher_unchanged=True,runway_start_front_design_m=p.runway_start_front_m,
            runway_must_be_reached_by_actual_wheel_motion=True,flight_id=self.flight_id,
            observed_clean_air=air,observed_qualified=o['qualified'],observed_crossed2=tuple(o['crossed2']),
            observed_original_success=o['original_success'],observed_original_done=o['original_done'],
            original_success_only_source_of_success=True,failure_reason=self.failure_reason,
            top_support_cue_is_control_feedback_not_qualification=True,
            raw_saturation6=tuple(abs(a-b)>1e-12 for a,b in zip(unbounded,raw)),
            process_ready_observed_not_overridden=o['process_ready'],
            feedforward_is_nominal_not_actual_motor_torque=True,
            physical_teacher_valid=False,no_state_force_reset_or_goal_write=True)


def parameters_from_own_seed(import_contract,projected_seed,bounded_lp,own_geometry):
    names=projected_seed['joint_names'];indices=[names.index(n) for n in ACTION_ORDER[:4]]
    q=projected_seed['q30_reference_only'];stand=tuple(float(q[0][j]) for j in indices);tuck=tuple(float(q[4][j]) for j in indices)
    rows={row['pose']:row for row in bounded_lp['rows']}
    ext_tau=tuple(rows['extension']['tau6_Nm'][:4]);tuck_tau=tuple(rows['tuck']['tau6_Nm'][:4])
    mass=sum(b['mass_kg'] for b in import_contract['bodies'].values());radius=import_contract['wheel_motor']['wheel_radius_m']
    h=projected_seed['seed_pose_diagnostics']['extension']['COM_floor_reference_z_m']-radius
    wheel_acceleration_gain=2*.6/(mass*radius);frequency=4.;damping_ratio=.9
    forward_gain,proof=wheel_forward_gains_from_own_fk(import_contract,own_geometry,names,q[0])
    values=dict(q_stand4=stand,q_crouch4=tuck,q_air_tuck4=tuck,q_land4=blend(stand,tuck,.35),
        push_tau_crouch4=tuck_tau,push_tau_extend4=ext_tau,
        teacher_vx=float(projected_seed['variables']['vx_m_s']),acceleration_s=float(projected_seed['variables']['acceleration_s']),
        wheel_radius_m=radius,wheel_forward_gain2_m=forward_gain,wheel_pitch_gain=(9.81+h*frequency**2)/wheel_acceleration_gain,
        wheel_pitch_rate_gain=2*damping_ratio*frequency*h/wheel_acceleration_gain,speed_error_gain=2/wheel_acceleration_gain)
    return TeacherParameters(**values)


def observation_from_existing_callback(cache,meta):
    """ROOT's unbatched N1 original-phase cache -> scalar source inputs.

    cache: kw/result/last_measured from ONE original physical(**kw) call;
    meta: original next-action clock/done, existing root buffer and origin.
    No contact query, state extrapolation, model, RNG or source-env mutation.
    The top cue is explicitly an engineering controller cue, not a claim that
    original top12/stable200 or same-flight qualification has been attained.
    """
    if cache is None:raise ValueError('Initial callback measurements UNKNOWN; use bootstrap(actual q30) once')
    kw=cache['kw'];result=cache['result'];last=cache['last_measured'];origin=meta['env_origin3_world']
    low=last['step_wheel_min'];high=last['step_wheel_max'];forces=tuple(float(x) for x in kw['wheel_N'])
    bottom=tuple(float(x[2]-origin[2]) for x in low);front=tuple(float(x[0]-origin[0]) for x in high)
    top_face=last['step_platform_contact']
    top_cue=tuple(bool(top_face[i]) and forces[i]>1. and bottom[i]>=.269 for i in (0,1))
    root=meta['root_xyz_world'];world_v=meta['root_vxyz_world'];world_w=meta['root_omega_xyz_world']
    o=dict(episode_id=int(meta['episode_id']),global_control=int(meta['global_control']),
        public_age=int(meta['public_age_for_action']),request_active=meta['request_active_for_action'],
        process_ready=meta.get('process_ready',None),qualified=meta.get('reward126_qualified',None),
        root_pitch=float(kw['pitch']),root_roll=float(kw['roll']),root_yaw=float(kw['yaw']),
        root_y=float(root[1]-origin[1]),world_velocity3=tuple(float(x) for x in world_v),
        world_angular_velocity3=tuple(float(x) for x in world_w),wheel_front2=front,wheel_bottom2=bottom,wheel_N2=forces,
        clean_air_now=result['air'],top_support_cue2=top_cue,
        full_footprint=all(last['step_footprint_inside']),crossed2=tuple(bool(x) for x in last['step_first_cross_clear']),
        original_success=last['step_goal_success'],original_done=meta['original_done'],
        actual_command_vx=float(meta['actual_command_vx']),
        original_stable_callbacks=last['step_stable_ticks'],prepared_now=result['prepared'],
        top_cue_source='cached_query_top_ID_and_existing_force_gt1_and_bottom_ge269mm_CONTROL_CUE_ONLY')
    if 'q30' in meta and 'joint_names' in meta:
        o['actual_joint_q4']=tuple(float(meta['q30'][meta['joint_names'].index(n)]) for n in ACTION_ORDER[:4])
    validate_observation(o);return o

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%% 定义固定量 %%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

%参考哈工程开源（https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/563048952）受力分析及其参数

%K与腿长l_0相关，在单片机难以算出，通过不同定点腿长拟合出K，从而在单片机上之间用
L_0s=0.03:0.005:0.50;            %腿长最小值：步长：腿长最大值,单位：m
Ks=zeros(2,6,length(L_0s));     %存放不同L_0对应的K

for step=1:length(L_0s)

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%% 定义变量 %%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

syms theta theta1 theta2;       %摆杆与竖值方向夹角及其导数
syms x x1 x2;                   %驱动轮位移及其导数
syms phi phi1 phi2;             %机体与水平夹角及其导数
syms T Tp N P Nm Pm Nf t;       %受力特征

k=sym('K',[2 6]);               %将对K的每个元素关于L_0拟合
syms L_0;
K = sym(zeros(2, 6));

L=L_0s(step)/2;                 %摆杆重心到驱动轮轴距离       单位：m
Lm=L_0s(step)/2;                %摆杆重心到机体转轴距离       单位：m

%机器人结构特征
r=0.06;                         %驱动轮半径                  单位：m
l=0.0;                           %机体重心到其转轴距离         单位：m
Mw=0.6;                          %驱动轮转子质量              单位：kg
Mp=0.95;                         %摆杠质量                    单位：kg
M=22-0.6*2-0.95*2;               %机体质量                    单位：kg
Iw=0.5*Mw*r^2;                   %驱动轮转子转动惯量           单位：kg*m^2
Ip=0.042737089;                  %摆杆绕质心转动惯量           单位：kg*m^2   
Im=0.393175574/2*3;                  %机体绕质心转动惯量           单位：kg*m^2    
g=9.8;                           %重力加速度                  单位：m/s^2  

%Q和R矩阵权重                    %Q和R矩阵权重选取负责调参
Q=diag([1 100 200 500 20000 1]);%1 1 500 1000 7000 1 &1 100 200 500 20000 1
R=diag([35 1 ]);%60 1  %30 1 

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%% 经典力学分析 %%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

%受力：
Nm=M*(x2+(L+Lm)*theta2*cos(theta)-(L+Lm)*theta1^2*sin(theta)-L*(phi2*cos(phi)-phi1^2*sin(phi)));
Pm=M*g+M*(-(L+Lm)*theta2*sin(theta)-(L+Lm)*theta1^2*cos(theta)-l*phi2*sin(phi)-l*phi1^2*cos(phi));
N=Nm+Mp*(x2+L*theta2*cos(theta)-L*theta1^2*sin(theta));
P=Pm+Mp*g+Mp*(-L*theta1^2*cos(theta)-L*theta2*sin(theta));

%力矩：

%是方程关系而不是直接的显示计算
% x2=(T-N*r)/(Iw/r+Mw*r);
% theta2=((P*L+Pm*Lm)*sin(theta)-(N*L+Nm*Lm)*cos(theta)-T+Tp)/Ip;
% phi2=(Tp+Nm*l*cos(phi)+Pm*l*sin(phi))/Im;

equ1=x2-(T-N*r)/(Iw/r+Mw*r);
equ2=(P*L+Pm*Lm)*sin(theta)-(N*L+Nm*Lm)*cos(theta)-T+Tp-Ip*theta2;
equ3=Tp+Nm*l*cos(phi)+Pm*l*sin(phi)-Im*phi2;
[x2,theta2,phi2]=solve(equ1,equ2,equ3,x2,theta2,phi2);

%通过x1=Ax+Bu求出AB
%jacobian(x1,u),求出关于x1和u关系的矩阵
Ja=jacobian([theta1;theta2;x1;x2;phi1;phi2],[theta theta1 x x1 phi phi1]);
Jb=jacobian([theta1;theta2;x1;x2;phi1;phi2],[T Tp]);
%带入平衡状态的条件
A=vpa(subs(Ja,[theta theta1 x x1 phi phi1],[0 0 0 0 0 0]));
B=vpa(subs(Jb,[theta theta1 x x1 phi phi1],[0 0 0 0 0 0]));
%离散化处理
[G,H]=c2d(eval(A),eval(B),0.001);
%求解当前腿长状态下的K
Ks(:,:,step)=dlqr(G,H,Q,R);

end

for x=1:2
    for y=1:6
        p=polyfit(L_0s,reshape(Ks(x,y,:),1,length(L_0s)),3);
        K(x,y)=p(1)*L_0^3+p(2)*L_0^2+p(3)*L_0+p(4);
    end
end

matlabFunction(K,'File','LQR_K');

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%% 定义固定量 %%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

%参考哈工程开源（https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/563048952）平面五连杆模型及其参数
l_1=0.21;           %单位：m
l_2=0.25;          %单位：m
l_3=l_2;            %单位：m
l_4=l_1;            %单位：m
l_AE=0.0;         %电机中心距,单位：m

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%% 定义变量 %%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

syms phi1 phi2 phi3 phi4;   %求虚拟腿长和腿长角角度过程量
syms d_phi1 d_phi4;         %关节电机的角度
syms xc yc xd yd xb yb;     %求虚拟腿长和腿长角坐标过程量
syms F Tp;                  %求虚拟腿长受到的力和扭矩

%%%%%%%%%%% VMC 通过关节电机角度求虚拟腿长和腿长角 %%%%%%%%%%%

%描述变量之间的关系
xb=l_1*cos(phi1);
yb=l_1*sin(phi1);
xd=l_AE+l_4*cos(phi4);
yd=l_4*sin(phi4);

A0=2*l_2*(xd-xb);
B0=2*l_2*(yd-yb);
C0=l_2^2+(xd-xb)^2+(yd-yb)^2-l_3^2;
phi2=2*atan((B0+sqrt(A0^2+B0^2-C0^2))/(A0+C0));

xc=xb+l_2*cos(phi2);
yc=yb+l_2*sin(phi2);
l_0=sqrt((xc-l_AE/2)^2+yc^2);
phi0=atan2(yc,xc-l_AE/2);

%五连杆末端的位姿与关节电机的关系
position=[l_0,phi0];
matlabFunction(position,'File','leg_position');

%表示l_0和phi0与phi1和phi4之间的关系
J11=diff(l_0,phi1);
J12=diff(l_0,phi4);
J21=diff(phi0,phi1);
J22=diff(phi0,phi4);
JacobianMatrix=[J11 J12;J21 J22];

%五连杆末端位姿变化率与关节电机的关系
speed=JacobianMatrix*[d_phi1;d_phi4];
matlabFunction(speed,'File','leg_speed');

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%% 定义固定量 %%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

%参考哈工程开源（https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/563048952）平面五连杆模型及其参数
l_1=0.16;           %单位：m
l_2=0.25;          %单位：m
l_3=l_2;            %单位：m
l_4=l_1;            %单位：m
l_AE=0.105;         %电机中心距,单位：m

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%% 定义变量 %%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

%%%%%%%%%%% VMC 通过关节电机角度求虚拟腿长和腿长角 %%%%%%%%%%%

%描述变量之间的关系
xb=l_1*cos(phi1);
yb=l_1*sin(phi1);
xd=l_AE+l_4*cos(phi4);
yd=l_4*sin(phi4);

A0=2*l_2*(xd-xb);
B0=2*l_2*(yd-yb);
C0=l_2^2+(xd-xb)^2+(yd-yb)^2-l_3^2;
phi2=2*atan((B0+sqrt(A0^2+B0^2-C0^2))/(A0+C0));

xc=xb+l_2*cos(phi2);
yc=yb+l_2*sin(phi2);
l_0=sqrt((xc-l_AE/2)^2+yc^2);
phi0=atan2(yc,xc-l_AE/2);

%五连杆末端的位姿与关节电机的关系
position=[l_0,phi0];
matlabFunction(position,'File','leg_position');

%表示l_0和phi0与phi1和phi4之间的关系
J11=diff(l_0,phi1);
J12=diff(l_0,phi4);
J21=diff(phi0,phi1);
J22=diff(phi0,phi4);
JacobianMatrix=[J11 J12;J21 J22];

%五连杆末端位姿变化率与关节电机的关系
speed=JacobianMatrix*[d_phi1;d_phi4];
matlabFunction(speed,'File','leg_speed');

%参考灯哥的一阶倒立摆模型

m=8.3;                            %摆杆质量
h=0.1;                            %腿长h
I=m*h^2;                            %摆杆转动惯量
g=9.8;                          %重力加速度
r=0.0875;                            %轮子半径
M=0.942;                            %轮子质量
D=(M+m)*(m*h^2+I)-m^2*h^2;

A=[0 1 0 0;((M+m)*(m*g*h)/D) 0 0 0;0 0 0 1;-(m^2*g*h^2)/D 0 0 0];
B=[0;-(m*h)/(D*r);0;1/((M+m)*r-(m^2*h^2)/((M+m)*D*r))];
Q=diag([1 1 1 1]);
R=5;

K=lqr(A,B,Q,R);

# Supplied SPR MATLAB source: useful structure and remaining limits

The source-only review found a useful LQR/VMC control architecture, but has not established a complete, physically validated jump onto a 270mm platform.

`ABK.m` and `ABK2.m` form a six-state wheel/virtual-leg/body balance model, with wheel torque and virtual hip torque as two inputs. They compute discrete LQR gains at a range of leg lengths and fit gain polynomials. `VMC.m`/`VMC2.m` derive virtual leg length/angle and map axial force plus virtual torque through a Jacobian transpose to joint torques. These are useful ways to coordinate acceleration, balance and leg motion. Their five-bar geometry, mass/inertia, wheel radii, sampling times and fitted gains belong to their robot and have not been adopted for MOD4.

The four supplied SLX models were read as ZIP/XML source only. No foreign MATLAB script, model, callback, compiled component or MAT workspace was executed or loaded. All XML sources are retained with path/bytes/SHA indexes. `LQR_Control_with_VMC.slx` contains calls to `JointVMC`, `LQR_VMC(L)` and `LQR_VMC_Controller`. Its two displayed `OffGroundDetection` scripts have the gain-changing branches commented out and return the supplied gain unchanged. The smaller `my_control` models call `LQR_K` and `leg_force`. This inspection did not find a complete accelerate/crouch/push/air-tuck/platform-cross/landing/stability teacher state machine. External function dependencies have not yet been resolved, so the absence of a complete teacher from this inspected scope does not prove one cannot exist elsewhere in the archive.

`LMPC.m` has zero-initialized gain storage and commented LQR calculation; it is not evidence of a ready constrained MPC controller. A force-balance expression in `ABK2.m` uses a leg lever where the declared body COM lever is different; its equations require independent checking before reuse.

For MOD4, the immediate change is to compute balance and original-action feedforward for the *actual reset pose*. The consumed teacher140V2 preparation trace starts at leg action coordinates approximately [-0.2237883, 0.3417617, -0.2237883, 0.3417617], base height 0.247m and zero velocity. The old controller interpolated in 0.5s toward approximately [0.1918371, -0.2407030, 0.1840681, -0.2485990] without ground static motor compensation. It then accelerated backwards and terminated on bad orientation at 1.27s. The exact previous-state wheel control formula reproduces the recorded requests to 8.89e-16 maximum raw-action residual. This establishes the behavior of this teacher prototype; it does not establish a unique cause for historical policy failures.

The new own-model controller must preserve original action6 ordering, PD/effort envelope, CAD coupling, gas law, delay, reset/contact dynamics and 2mm physical closure guard. MATLAB computes references and gains; original PhysX determines whether real motor actions can execute the complete jump. No teacher ingestion, new learning or successful MuJoCo teacher playback is approved from this source review alone.
